# Task 13 environment variables (read per request by `api/plugins/demo_session.py`)

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DEMO_PUBLIC_ENABLED` | unset (off) | `1/true/yes/on` enables `POST /auth/demo-session`. Off -> `404 not_found`, identical to an unknown route. |
| `DEMO_SESSION_MINUTES` | `30` | Lifetime of the demo access token. Valid 1-1440; malformed or out of range -> 30. |
| `DEMO_SESSION_RATE_LIMIT` | `20/hour` | Sessions per client IP. Malformed -> `20/hour`. 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After`. Counter is in process memory (per worker, reset on restart). |

Related:
- `TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS` (`api/rate_limit.py`): behind a proxy, set it correctly or all visitors share one budget.
- The account `demo_viewer` (role `viewer`) must exist: `DEMO_MODE=true python scripts/demo_seed.py`. Missing or promoted -> `503 demo_unavailable`.

Behaviour: token claims `sub`, `role=viewer`, `demo=true`, `exp`; no refresh token. A demo token gets `403 demo_read_only` on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE except `/auth/ws-ticket`, `/auth/refresh`, `/auth/logout`, `/auth/login`, `/auth/demo-session`, `/client-errors`, `/api/client-errors`, `/api/copilot/ask`.
